question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write five complete sentences.

guide_solution: Matching (a) Conflict between teenagers and parents is very common and one of the major problems of modern age. (b) One certain reason of conflict is the difficult behaviours of the adolescents which are common features of the teenagers. (c) Moody and sulky behaviours are the kind of behaviours that are the result of loneliness and communication gap. (d) Consequently, adolescents are self-centered and want to think for themselves. (e) They rebel against the ways and thoughts of older generation which they think are outdated.
